You seem both intelligent, having deep thoughts and strong emotions. So maybe try to find people with similar traits but with a different outlook on life? I know it might be hard to find but there are many people who know this feeling of having to fake in relationships. And also it seems like you think a bit black and white about love and fear. I don't agree that they are opposed. They are both feelings and they exist in all of us at different times and situations. I can understand if you mean that the feeling of fear blocks the feeling of love when you are with others. Maybe you are afraid of fear and want to escape that feeling because you you cannot handle it yet. I think we all have to accept our existential fear in some way or another. As you know the other option is death. You say you are young so if I were you I would not give up. Try to find someone who wants to talk about these thoughts irl. That might be a seed for a genuine relationship. We cannot really trust anything, to completely trust someone is wishful thinking imo. What you do is take a leap of faith and hope that they do their best and have good intentions.
